nodes.title: Class 10 (Metric)
nodes.summary: First major board. Opens Class 12 streams, polytechnic, ITI, and later every mapped profession through those routes.
nodes.outlook: Pick a Class 12 stream that matches the professions you are curious about. Science keeps the most technical doors open.
nodes.costGovt: Mostly free to ₹15,000 / year (govt / aided school)

nodes.title: Class 12 Science — PCM
nodes.summary: Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics. Standard route into engineering, architecture, computing, pure sciences, defence academies, and commercial pilot theory.
nodes.outlook: Sit engineering and architecture entrances, or continue into B.Sc / BCA.
nodes.costGovt: Mostly free to ₹20,000 / year (govt / aided + board fees)

nodes.title: Class 12 Science — PCB
nodes.summary: Physics, Chemistry, Biology. Primary path into medicine, dentistry, AYUSH, veterinary, pharmacy, nursing, and life sciences.
nodes.outlook: NEET-UG is the main medical gate. Keep B.Sc life sciences as a parallel plan.
nodes.costGovt: Mostly free to ₹20,000 / year (govt / aided + board fees)

nodes.title: Class 12 Science — PCMB
nodes.summary: All four science subjects. Keeps both engineering and medical options open at the cost of a heavier Class 12 load.
nodes.outlook: Useful if you are genuinely undecided between PCM and PCB careers.
nodes.costGovt: Mostly free to ₹20,000 / year (govt / aided + board fees)

nodes.title: Class 12 Commerce
nodes.summary: Accountancy, business studies, economics. Launch pad for CA, CS, CMA, B.Com, BBA, banking, and later MBA.
nodes.outlook: You can start CA Foundation in Class 12 or take a bachelor’s first.
nodes.costGovt: Mostly free to ₹20,000 / year (govt / aided + board fees)

nodes.title: Class 12 Arts / Humanities
nodes.summary: History, political science, sociology, psychology, languages. Feeds law, journalism, civil services, teaching, design, and social work.
nodes.outlook: A B.A. plus a targeted exam (CLAT, UPSC, design) is a common pattern.
nodes.costGovt: Mostly free to ₹20,000 / year (govt / aided + board fees)

nodes.title: Class 12 Vocational / Applied
nodes.summary: Applied streams such as IT, retail, hospitality, or healthcare at senior secondary. Can continue to diplomas or related bachelor’s degrees.
nodes.outlook: Map the vocational subject to a diploma or bachelor in the same field.

nodes.title: ITI / NCVT Certificate
nodes.summary: Trade training (electrician, fitter, welder, COPA, and others) for apprenticeships and skilled jobs.
nodes.outlook: Many later join a polytechnic diploma or a PSU apprenticeship.

nodes.title: Polytechnic Diploma (Engineering)
nodes.summary: Hands-on engineering after Class 10. Work as a technician or take lateral entry into B.Tech year two.
nodes.outlook: A practical engineering start that still keeps the full B.Tech path open.

nodes.title: Polytechnic Diploma (Aeronautical Engineering)
nodes.summary: Hands-on aircraft structures, propulsion, and maintenance after Class 10. Work as a technician or take lateral entry into B.Tech Aeronautical or Aerospace year two.
nodes.outlook: Technician and MRO helper roles first; B.Tech lateral entry keeps the engineer title open.
institutes: Hindustan Institute of Technology and Science

nodes.title: D.Pharm
nodes.summary: Diploma in pharmacy. Allows registered pharmacist practice in retail/hospital under council rules; B.Pharm is the upgrade.
nodes.outlook: Register with the pharmacy council; consider B.Pharm lateral entry.

nodes.title: GNM (General Nursing & Midwifery)
nodes.summary: Diploma nursing programme. Leads to registered nurse roles; B.Sc Nursing post-basic is a common upgrade.
nodes.outlook: Hospitals hire GNM nurses; post-basic B.Sc widens promotion and overseas options.

nodes.title: Diploma in Hotel Management
nodes.summary: Food production, front office, and housekeeping training for hotels and catering.
nodes.outlook: Can later join BHM or work up through hotel operations.

nodes.title: ANM (Auxiliary Nurse Midwifery)
nodes.summary: Community and maternal-health nursing diploma, often used in rural public-health posts.
nodes.outlook: A public-health nursing start; GNM or B.Sc Nursing can follow.

nodes.title: B.Tech Computer Science
nodes.summary: B.Tech Computer Science after Class 12 PCM (or lateral entry from diploma). Branch choice shapes the first job more than the college brand alone.
exams: JEE Main / Advanced or state CET
nodes.outlook: Placements, GATE, CAT, and civil services are all common next moves.

nodes.title: B.Tech Aeronautical Engineering
nodes.summary: B.Tech Aeronautical Engineering after Class 12 PCM (or lateral entry from a related diploma). Aircraft inside the atmosphere — aerodynamics, structures, propulsion, and maintenance — rather than spacecraft systems.
exams: JEE Main / Advanced or state CET
GATE AE later for M.Tech / PSU
nodes.outlook: HAL, DRDO, NAL, airline MRO, and private aviation OEMs. Core seats are few; GATE AE, a mechanical pivot, or software are common backups.
institutes: Hindustan Institute of Technology and Science

nodes.title: BCA
nodes.summary: Bachelor of Computer Applications. Computing degree; maths in Class 12 helps but is not always mandatory.
nodes.outlook: Direct software path; MCA or a specialised master’s strengthens it.

nodes.title: B.Arch
nodes.summary: Professional architecture degree recognised by the Council of Architecture.
nodes.outlook: Firms, urban design, interiors, or a master’s in planning.
institutes: Sir J.J. College of Architecture, Mumbai

nodes.title: B.Des
nodes.summary: Bachelor of Design (product, communication, UX, or similar) via NID/IIT/private design schools.
nodes.outlook: Portfolio is the hiring document. M.Des optional.

nodes.title: BFA / BVA
nodes.summary: Bachelor of Fine Arts. Studio practice in painting, sculpture, applied art, or related disciplines.
nodes.outlook: Studios, teaching, illustration, or design-adjacent work.
institutes: Faculty of Fine Arts, MSU Baroda
Kalakshetra / Government College of Fine Arts, Chennai

exams: IIT JAM later for many M.Sc programmes
nodes.outlook: Pair with M.Sc, B.Ed, MCA, or professional master’s as needed.

nodes.title: MBBS
nodes.summary: Primary medical qualification in India. After internship and registration you may practise; MD/MS for most specialties.
nodes.outlook: General practice, government service, or postgraduate specialisation.

nodes.title: BDS
nodes.summary: Bachelor of Dental Surgery. Dentist after council registration; MDS for specialisation.
nodes.outlook: Clinics, hospitals, public health dentistry.

nodes.title: BAMS
nodes.summary: Bachelor of Ayurvedic Medicine and Surgery. Ayurveda physician after council registration.
nodes.outlook: AYUSH hospitals, private practice, wellness industry, or MD Ayurveda.

nodes.title: BHMS
nodes.summary: Bachelor of Homeopathic Medicine and Surgery.
nodes.outlook: Clinics and AYUSH services; check current practice regulations.

nodes.title: BUMS
nodes.summary: Bachelor of Unani Medicine and Surgery.
nodes.outlook: Unani hospitals and private practice.

nodes.title: B.V.Sc & A.H.
nodes.summary: Veterinary science and animal husbandry. Qualifies veterinarians for clinical, farm, and government roles.
nodes.outlook: Clinics, dairies, government AH departments, research.

nodes.title: B.Pharm
nodes.summary: Undergraduate pharmacy: drug science, dispensing, and industry manufacturing.
nodes.outlook: Retail, hospital, industry, regulatory affairs.

nodes.title: Pharm.D
nodes.summary: Doctor of Pharmacy — clinically oriented pharmacy degree with hospital residency-style training.
nodes.outlook: Hospitals, clinical research, pharmacovigilance.
institutes: JSS College of Pharmacy, Ooty / Mysuru

nodes.title: BPT (Physiotherapy)
nodes.summary: Bachelor of Physiotherapy with clinical internships in rehab and orthopaedics.
nodes.outlook: Hospitals, sports clinics, private practice, MPT.

nodes.title: BOT (Occupational Therapy)
nodes.summary: Occupational therapy degree focused on function and daily living after injury or disability.
nodes.outlook: Rehab centres, hospitals, paediatric OT, MOT.
institutes: National Institute for Locomotor Disabilities related programmes

nodes.title: BASLP
nodes.summary: Bachelor in Audiology and Speech-Language Pathology.
nodes.outlook: Hospitals, schools, private clinics, MASLP.

nodes.title: B.Optom
nodes.summary: Optometry degree for primary eye care, refraction, and optical practice.
nodes.outlook: Optical retail, hospitals, private practice.

nodes.title: B.Sc Medical Lab Technology
nodes.summary: Laboratory diagnostics degree for pathology, microbiology, and biochemistry labs.
nodes.outlook: Hospitals, diagnostic chains, research labs.

nodes.title: B.Sc Radiology / Imaging
nodes.summary: Medical imaging technology (X-ray, CT, MRI support) under radiologist supervision.
nodes.outlook: Hospitals and diagnostic centres.

nodes.title: B.Com
nodes.summary: Accountancy, finance, and business law. Pairs with CA, CS, CMA, or MBA.
nodes.outlook: Accounts, banking, tax, or professional qualifications on top.

nodes.title: B.Com (Hons)
nodes.summary: Honours commerce with deeper accounting and finance papers. Favoured for CA and campus finance.
nodes.outlook: Same onward paths as B.Com with a stronger finance signal.

nodes.title: BBA
nodes.summary: Bachelor of Business Administration. Management runway to MBA or corporate roles.
nodes.outlook: Management trainee roles, family business, then often MBA.
institutes: Shaheed Sukhdev College of Business Studies, Delhi

nodes.title: BMS
nodes.summary: Bachelor of Management Studies — similar to BBA, common in some universities.
nodes.outlook: Treat as a BBA-equivalent for later MBA and corporate roles.

nodes.title: B.A. English
nodes.summary: Literature and writing-intensive arts degree. Media, teaching, civil services, and publishing are common follow-ons.
nodes.outlook: Add B.Ed, journalism internships, UPSC, or an MBA as a next filter.

nodes.title: B.A. History
nodes.summary: History honours — a frequent UPSC optional and teaching subject.
nodes.outlook: Civil services, teaching, museums, research M.A.

nodes.title: B.A. Political Science
nodes.summary: Political science — common for UPSC, journalism, and policy internships.
nodes.outlook: UPSC, journalism, law (3-year LL.B.), policy master’s.

nodes.title: B.A. / B.Sc Economics
nodes.summary: Economics honours. Quant track if maths is included — useful for analyst, RBI/UPSC, and master’s abroad or DSE/ISI.
nodes.outlook: Analyst roles, IES/UPSC, M.A. Economics, MBA.

nodes.title: B.A. / B.Sc Psychology
nodes.summary: Undergraduate psychology. Independent clinical practice in India typically needs a recognised master’s (and RCI pathways where applicable).
nodes.outlook: M.A./M.Sc Psychology, counselling, HR, or research.

nodes.title: B.A. Sociology
nodes.summary: Sociology — social research, development sector, UPSC, and social work master’s.
nodes.outlook: NGOs, research, MSW, civil services.

nodes.title: BSW
nodes.summary: Bachelor of Social Work with field placements in NGOs and community settings.
nodes.outlook: NGOs, CSR, MSW for deeper practice.
institutes: Delhi School of Social Work (later MSW)

nodes.title: B.A. Journalism / BJMC
nodes.summary: Journalism and mass communication undergraduate. Internships and a clip file matter as much as the degree.
nodes.outlook: Newsrooms, digital media, PR; M.A. Journalism optional.

nodes.title: B.A. LL.B. (5-year)
nodes.summary: Integrated law after Class 12. Graduates enrol as advocates.
nodes.outlook: Litigation, firms, in-house, judiciary, LL.M.

nodes.title: LL.B. (3-year)
nodes.summary: Law after any bachelor’s degree. Same advocate enrolment as the five-year course.
exams: DU LL.B. / MHCET Law / university tests
nodes.outlook: Useful if you discovered law after another bachelor’s.
institutes: Campus Law Centre, University of Delhi

nodes.title: BHM / B.Sc Hospitality
nodes.summary: Hotel and hospitality management. Operations across F&B, rooms, and events.
nodes.outlook: Hotels, airlines catering, QSR, MBA later.

nodes.title: B.Pharm (Ayurveda) / related
nodes.summary: Ayurvedic / herbal pharmacy programmes where offered — industry and AYUSH dispensing.
nodes.outlook: AYUSH manufacturing and pharmacies.

nodes.title: B.P.Ed
nodes.summary: Physical education bachelor’s for school PE teaching and coaching pathways.
nodes.outlook: Schools, academies; M.P.Ed for advancement.

nodes.title: B.El.Ed
nodes.summary: Integrated elementary education degree (notably Delhi University model) for primary teaching.
nodes.outlook: Primary schools; TET still required for many government posts.

nodes.title: CA Foundation
nodes.summary: First ICAI level. Can be attempted around Class 12 windows.
nodes.outlook: Then Intermediate + articleship.

nodes.title: CA Intermediate
nodes.summary: Second CA level. Articleship begins after groups as per ICAI rules.
nodes.outlook: Final after required training.

nodes.title: CA Final
nodes.summary: Last ICAI exam before membership.
nodes.outlook: Practice, industry finance, Big Four.

nodes.title: CS Executive
nodes.summary: Company Secretary Executive programme (ICSI) after Foundation or a graduate entry route.
nodes.outlook: Then Professional programme + training.

nodes.title: CS Professional
nodes.summary: Final ICSI academic stage before membership.
nodes.outlook: Company secretary roles in listed companies and practice.

nodes.title: CMA Intermediate
nodes.summary: ICMAI Intermediate after Foundation or graduate entry.
nodes.outlook: Then Final and practical training.

nodes.title: CMA Final
nodes.summary: Final CMA qualification stage.
nodes.outlook: Manufacturing finance, cost audit, industry.

nodes.title: NDA / Service Academy
nodes.summary: National Defence Academy after Class 12, or equivalent academy entries. Leads to a commission.
nodes.outlook: Army, Navy, or Air Force officer subject to branch and medicals.
nodes.costGovt: Academy training is paid by the government (stipend)

nodes.title: CDS / OTA / IMA entry training
nodes.summary: Combined Defence Services and related graduate entries into IMA, INA, AFA, OTA.
nodes.outlook: Commissioned officer after academy.
nodes.costGovt: Academy training is paid by the government (stipend)

nodes.title: M.Tech / M.E.
nodes.summary: Postgraduate engineering via GATE. Specialist industry, R&D, teaching.
nodes.outlook: Specialist engineer, labs, Ph.D., teaching.
nodes.costGovt: ₹20,000–₹1 lakh / year (IIT / NIT; GATE stipend possible)

nodes.title: MCA
nodes.summary: Master of Computer Applications after BCA or eligible B.Sc.
nodes.outlook: Software hiring; stronger signal than BCA alone at many campuses.

nodes.title: MBA / PGDM
nodes.summary: Postgraduate management. Consulting, product, marketing, ops, IB depending on school.
nodes.outlook: School quality and internships matter as much as the title.

nodes.title: M.Sc (Science)
nodes.summary: Master’s in a science discipline — research, analytics, teaching (NET), industry science.
nodes.outlook: NET/JRF, labs, or Ph.D.

nodes.title: M.A.
nodes.summary: Master of Arts in the undergraduate subject or an allied field.
nodes.outlook: NET for college teaching, UPSC, specialist roles.

nodes.title: MD / MS
nodes.summary: Medical postgraduate specialisation. MD medicine-side; MS surgery-side.
nodes.outlook: Consultant practice or super-speciality DM/MCh.

nodes.title: MDS
nodes.summary: Master of Dental Surgery — specialist dentist.
nodes.outlook: Specialty practice and teaching hospitals.

nodes.title: M.Pharm
nodes.summary: Master of Pharmacy via GPAT. Industry R&D, QA, academia.
nodes.outlook: Pharma R&D, regulatory, teaching.

nodes.title: LL.M.
nodes.summary: Master of Laws for academic, policy, or specialised practice depth.
nodes.outlook: Academia, specialist firms, policy.

nodes.title: M.Des
nodes.summary: Master of Design. Deepens undergraduate design or converts some engineers/architects.
nodes.outlook: Specialist design roles and studios.

nodes.title: MSW
nodes.summary: Master of Social Work — development sector, hospitals, CSR, policy NGOs.
nodes.outlook: NGOs, hospitals, government schemes, CSR.

nodes.title: MPH
nodes.summary: Master of Public Health after a health or life-science bachelor’s (rules vary by school).
nodes.outlook: Govt public health, WHO/UN internships, NGOs, hospitals.

nodes.title: M.Ed
nodes.summary: Master of Education after B.Ed. Leadership, teacher education, research.
nodes.outlook: Teacher education institutes, school leadership.

nodes.title: MPT
nodes.summary: Master of Physiotherapy specialisation.
nodes.outlook: Specialty clinics and teaching.

nodes.title: B.Ed
nodes.summary: Bachelor of Education after a subject bachelor’s. Usual credential for school teaching.
nodes.outlook: Government and private schools.

nodes.title: Ph.D.
nodes.summary: Doctoral research after a relevant master’s (or integrated routes). Required for most permanent college/university teaching.
nodes.outlook: Academia, R&D labs, specialist industry research.

nodes.title: Software Engineer
nodes.summary: Builds software products and systems. Internships and projects matter as much as the exact degree.
nodes.outlook: Product, IT services, start-ups, later data/security/management.
nodes.salaryHint: About ₹4–18 LPA to start · ₹12–40 LPA after 5–8 years (services vs product)
certifications: AWS Certified Developer or Solutions Architect Associate
Oracle Java / Microsoft Azure Developer (if that is your stack)
Kubernetes CKA later, once you run systems in production

nodes.title: Data Scientist
nodes.summary: Models and decisions from data. Needs statistics plus programming, often after B.Tech, B.Sc stats/maths, or a master’s.
nodes.outlook: Analytics, product ML, research labs.
nodes.salaryHint: About ₹6–20 LPA to start · ₹15–40 LPA after 5–8 years
certifications: Google Advanced Data Analytics or TensorFlow Developer Certificate
AWS Certified Machine Learning – Specialty
A statistics MOOC plus Kaggle / GitHub beats a cert-only CV

nodes.title: Data Analyst
nodes.summary: Reporting, SQL, dashboards, and business insight. A common first data job before scientist/engineer roles.
nodes.outlook: Every industry hires analysts; a master’s is optional.
nodes.salaryHint: About ₹3.5–10 LPA to start · ₹8–20 LPA after 5–8 years
certifications: Google Data Analytics Certificate
Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst (PL-300)
Tableau Desktop Specialist

nodes.title: ML Engineer
nodes.summary: Production machine-learning systems — closer to software engineering than pure research science.
nodes.outlook: Usually after CSE/AI B.Tech or a strong software base.
nodes.salaryHint: About ₹8–25 LPA to start · ₹18–45 LPA after 5–8 years
certifications: TensorFlow Developer Certificate
AWS Certified Machine Learning – Specialty
Databricks or MLOps associate credentials once you ship models

nodes.title: Prompt Engineer
nodes.summary: Designs, tests, and improves prompts and LLM workflows so products get reliable answers from models like GPT or Gemini. Mix of clear writing, evaluation, and light Python/API work — not a substitute for full ML engineering.
exams: Portfolio of prompt systems; product interviews
nodes.outlook: AI product teams, start-ups, and IT services GenAI practices. Titles are still fluid; many roles sit inside software or content teams.
nodes.salaryHint: About ₹5–14 LPA early · ₹12–28 LPA when you own GenAI product quality
certifications: DeepLearning.AI / OpenAI prompt-engineering short courses
A public eval harness or prompt library on GitHub
Vendor GenAI associate certs (Azure AI / Google Cloud) if the employer asks

nodes.title: Cybersecurity Analyst
nodes.summary: Defends systems: SOC, pentest-adjacent, GRC. Degrees in CSE/IT plus certifications (Security+, OSCP later) are common.
nodes.outlook: IT, banks, consulting, government.
nodes.salaryHint: About ₹5–14 LPA to start · ₹12–30 LPA after 5–8 years
certifications: CompTIA Security+
CEH or CompTIA CySA+ for SOC roles
OSCP later if you want hands-on pentest work

nodes.title: UI / UX Designer
nodes.summary: Product interface and research. B.Des, B.Tech + portfolio, or design master’s.
nodes.outlook: Product companies and agencies; portfolio is mandatory.
nodes.salaryHint: About ₹4–12 LPA to start · ₹10–25 LPA after 5–8 years
certifications: Google UX Design Certificate
NN/g UX certificate (later, after a portfolio)
Figma professional coursework plus 3–5 case studies

nodes.title: Product Manager
nodes.summary: Owns product outcomes. Often after engineering/MBA plus internships; not a first-degree job for most.
nodes.outlook: Usually 1–3 years in another role or an MBA internship convert.
nodes.salaryHint: About ₹8–25 LPA to start · ₹20–45 LPA after 5–8 years
certifications: Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO)
Pragmatic Institute or AIPMM product certificates
A PM internship or shipped feature still counts more

nodes.title: Civil Engineer
nodes.summary: Buildings, roads, water, infrastructure. Civil B.Tech or diploma-plus-degree.

nodes.title: Economist

nodes.outlook: Think tanks, RBI/IES, consultancies, banks.

certifications: UGC-NET Economics (college teaching)
NISM / FRM Part I if you pivot to markets
R programming or data-analytics certificates help applied roles

nodes.title: Special Educator
nodes.summary: Inclusive education after B.Ed special education or RCI diplomas plus a bachelor’s.
nodes.outlook: Inclusive schools, NGOs, therapy centres.

certifications: CTET / state TET (school teaching)
UGC-NET (college / university)
RCI credentials if you work in special education

nodes.title: Environmental Scientist
nodes.summary: Impact, pollution, and conservation work after environmental science, forestry, or civil/chem with a relevant master’s.
nodes.outlook: Consultancies, pollution boards, NGOs.

institutes: TERI School of Advanced Studies, Delhi
certifications: QCI / NABET EIA functional-area training
ISO 14001 lead auditor
CSIR NET / GATE Environmental Science

nodes.title: Embedded Systems Engineer
nodes.summary: Firmware and hardware-near software. ECE/EE/CSE with C and microcontroller projects.
nodes.outlook: Automotive, IoT, electronics product firms.

certifications: GATE (M.Tech, PSU, teaching)
ESE / state engineering services where relevant
AutoCAD, SolidWorks, or PLC certificates matching the branch

nodes.title: Robotic & Automation Engineer
nodes.summary: Designs and commissions industrial robots, PLCs, and cell automation on the shop floor — pick-and-place, welding, packaging, and material handling. Mech/ECE/EE (or mechatronics) with PLC and robot-lab projects; software/ROS paths also exist.

nodes.outlook: Auto OEMs, ancillaries, FMCG plants, warehouses, and system integrators. Hands-on cell work beats a cert alone.

FANUC / ABB / KUKA robot programming courses
GATE (M.Tech / PSU) or industrial safety / Six Sigma where the plant asks

nodes.title: Game Developer
nodes.summary: Gameplay and engine work. CSE/B.Des/self-taught plus a shipped demo.
nodes.outlook: Studios and remote indie. Demo or GitHub is required.

certifications: Unity Certified User / Professional Programmer
Unreal Engine Professional

nodes.title: Full Stack Developer

AWS Certified Developer – Associate
MongoDB or PostgreSQL associate certificates matching your stack

nodes.title: Cloud Engineer
nodes.summary: Designs and runs applications on AWS, Azure, or GCP — networking, IAM, cost, and reliability.

Microsoft Azure Administrator (AZ-104)
Google Cloud Associate Cloud Engineer

Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305)
Google Professional Cloud Architect

nodes.title: DevOps Engineer
nodes.summary: Connects development and operations: CI/CD, containers, observability, and release safety.

certifications: Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)
HashiCorp Terraform Associate
AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional (after a few years)

nodes.title: QA / Automation Testing Engineer
nodes.summary: Writes automated tests and quality gates so software ships safely. Coding testers are preferred over purely manual QA.

certifications: ISTQB Foundation, then Advanced Test Automation
A Selenium / Playwright / API-testing portfolio
AWS Cloud Practitioner if you test cloud-native apps

nodes.title: Database Administrator
nodes.summary: Keeps databases available, fast, and recoverable — backups, tuning, access control, and increasingly cloud data platforms.

nodes.salaryHint: About ₹4–12 LPA to start · ₹10–25 LPA after 5–8 years
certifications: Oracle Database Administrator Certified Professional
Microsoft SQL Server / Azure Database Administrator Associate
PostgreSQL or MongoDB DBA certificates for open-source stacks

nodes.title: Business Analyst
nodes.summary: Turns business problems into requirements and process change. IT-BA work is a common path from computing degrees in Indian services firms.

nodes.salaryHint: About ₹4–12 LPA to start · ₹10–22 LPA after 5–8 years
certifications: IIBA ECBA, then CCBA / CBAP
PMI-PBA
SQL + a BI cert (PL-300 or Tableau) for IT-BA roles

nodes.title: B.Sc Geology / Applied Geology

nodes.outlook: M.Sc Geology is the usual next step for GSI, ONGC, and campus science roles. GATE GG opens PSUs.

nodes.title: B.Tech Mining Engineering
nodes.summary: Mine planning, rock mechanics, ventilation, and mineral extraction after Class 12 PCM (or lateral entry from diploma).

GATE MN later for M.Tech / PSU
nodes.outlook: Coal, metal, and limestone mines; DGMS exams; GATE for Coal India and other PSUs.

nodes.title: B.Tech Geological Engineering
nodes.summary: Applied geology for exploration, geotechnical work, and petroleum. Offered at a few engineering institutes (for example IIT-ISM style programmes).
exams: JEE Main / Advanced or state CET
GATE GG later for M.Tech / PSU
nodes.outlook: ONGC, mining houses, geotechnical consultancies, and hydro projects.

nodes.title: Geologist
nodes.summary: Maps rocks, structures, and resources for surveys, mines, infrastructure, and energy. An M.Sc in geology is the usual hiring bar in India.
exams: GATE GG; UPSC GSI / combined geologist; campus
nodes.outlook: GSI, state DGMs, mining companies, and consultancies. A Ph.D. helps for research posts.

certifications: GATE Geology / Geophysics
Esri / QGIS professional GIS certificates
CSIR NET Earth Sciences (academia)

nodes.title: Hydrogeologist
nodes.summary: Groundwater exploration, well design, and aquifer management — CGWB, state water boards, and irrigation / infra projects.
exams: GATE GG; CGWB / state water recruitments
nodes.outlook: Water boards, smart-city and irrigation consultancies, NGOs.
nodes.salaryHint: About ₹4–9 LPA · ₹8–18 LPA in govt / consultancy
certifications: GATE Geology / Geophysics
Esri / QGIS professional GIS certificates
CSIR NET Earth Sciences (academia)

nodes.title: Petroleum Geologist
nodes.summary: Finds and describes hydrocarbon reservoirs. Hired by ONGC, OIL, and service companies after geology, geophysics, or petroleum engineering.

nodes.outlook: Cyclical oil hiring; service companies (mudlogging, wellsite) are a common first role.
nodes.salaryHint: About ₹6–16 LPA to start · ₹15–35 LPA in oilfield roles
certifications: GATE Petroleum / Geology as relevant
IWCF / IADC well-control (oilfield roles)
SPE membership and short industry courses

nodes.title: Geophysicist

nodes.outlook: Oilfield, mineral exploration, and geotechnical surveys. Physics or geology plus a geophysics master’s is typical.

certifications: GATE Geology / Geophysics
Esri / QGIS professional GIS certificates
CSIR NET Earth Sciences (academia)

nodes.title: Mining Engineer
nodes.summary: Plans and runs mines — safety, production, and statutory compliance under DGMS.

certifications: GATE Mining
DGMS certificates of competency (mines manager / surveyor)
Mine-safety and blasting licences as the role requires

nodes.title: Geotechnical Engineer

nodes.salaryHint: About ₹4–10 LPA · ₹10–20 LPA in design / site firms
certifications: GATE (M.Tech, PSU, teaching)
ESE / state engineering services where relevant
AutoCAD, SolidWorks, or PLC certificates matching the branch

nodes.title: Engineering Geologist

certifications: GATE Geology / Geophysics
Esri / QGIS professional GIS certificates
CSIR NET Earth Sciences (academia)

certifications: GATE Geology / Geophysics
Esri / QGIS professional GIS certificates
CSIR NET Earth Sciences (academia)

nodes.outlook: Small specialist market — usually after M.Sc/M.Tech geophysics or physics.

certifications: GATE Geology / Geophysics
Esri / QGIS professional GIS certificates
CSIR NET Earth Sciences (academia)

nodes.title: Paleontologist

nodes.outlook: Academic and survey posts are few; biostratigraphy in oil companies is the industry variant.

certifications: GATE Geology / Geophysics
Esri / QGIS professional GIS certificates
CSIR NET Earth Sciences (academia)

certifications: GATE Geology / Geophysics
Esri / QGIS professional GIS certificates
CSIR NET Earth Sciences (academia)

nodes.salaryHint: About ₹5–12 LPA on national-lab scientist bands
certifications: GATE Geology / Geophysics
Esri / QGIS professional GIS certificates
CSIR NET Earth Sciences (academia)

nodes.summary: Identifies and grades gemstones for trade labs and jewellery houses. Geology helps; GIA/IGI-style diplomas are often what employers list.

certifications: GATE Geology / Geophysics
Esri / QGIS professional GIS certificates
CSIR NET Earth Sciences (academia)
